name: Prophecy of Air
description: Grants Arcana tied to the element of Air.
omenEffect: Grants an equal chance to reveal either one or all three Arcana.

name: Prophecy of Dead Eyes
description: Grants Arcana tied to Critical Hits.
omenEffect: Increases the power of each awakened Arcanum with at least five White Raven Feathers in the Inventory.

name: Prophecy of Destruction
description: Grants Arcana tied to firearm damage.
omenEffect: Significantly increases the power of the awakened Arcanum if it is in the fourth or later row of Arcana. The remaining Arcana slots become disabled.

name: Prophecy of Earth
description: Grants Arcana tied to the element of Earth.
omenEffect: Increases the power of each awakened Arcanum with at least five White Raven Feathers in the Inventory.

name: Prophecy of Fire
description: Grants Arcana tied to the element of Fire.
omenEffect: Significantly increases the power of each awakened Arcanum with at least ten White Raven Feathers in the Inventory.

name: Prophecy of Firearms
omenEffect: Significantly increases the power of the awakened Arcanum if it is in the sixth or seventh row of Arcana. The remaining Arcana slots become disabled.

name: Prophecy of Gunpowder
omenEffect: Significantly increases the power of each awakened Arcanum with at least ten White Raven Feathers in the Inventory.

name: Prophecy of Health
omenEffect: Increases the power of each Arcanum when all three slots are awakened.

name: Prophecy of Heaviness
description: Grants non-elemental Arcana tied to the Heavy Spell.
omenEffect: Unveils three Arcana instead of two.

name: Prophecy of Lightness
description: Grants non-elemental Arcana tied to the Light Spell.
omenEffect: Grants an equal chance to reveal either one or all three Arcana.

name: Prophecy of Nimble Fingers
description: Grants Arcana tied to reloading and handling of firearms.
omenEffect: Significantly increases the power of the awakened Arcanum but forgets two random awakened Arcana. Fails if no Arcana are available to be forgotten.

name: Prophecy of Spells
omenEffect: Increases the power of each Arcanum when all three slots are awakened.

name: Prophecy of Stamina
omenEffect: Makes the next row unveil all three Arcana, overriding its Prophecy if necessary and possible.

name: Prophecy of the Bull
description: Grants Arcana that enhance an aggressive combat style.
omenEffect: Grants an equal chance to reveal either one or all three Arcana.

name: Prophecy of the Serpent
description: Grants Arcana that enhance a cautious, tactical combat style.
omenEffect: Unveils three Arcana instead of two.

name: Prophecy of Variety
description: Grants Arcana unrelated to weapons and spells.
omenEffect: The awakened Arcana get a powerful boost that decreases with four absorbed Witchfire Manifestations and disappears with six.

name: Prophecy of Water
description: Grants Arcana tied to the element of Water.
omenEffect: Allows any Arcana in this row to be re-rolled with White Raven Feathers.

name: Prophecy of Witchfire
omenEffect: Makes the next row unveil all three Arcana, overriding its Prophecy if necessary and possible.
